主要内容: Royal Bank of Canada announced a share repurchase program, authorizing the repurchase of up to 20 million common shares. The initiative reflects the bank's confidence in its financial position and long-term value creation. The repurchase is intended to enhance shareholder returns and optimize capital structure. The program is subject to market conditions and regulatory approvals. The announcement was made on May 31, 2016. The Toronto Stock Exchange has approved the normal course issuer bid to purchase up to 20 million of its common shares for cancellation. The shares represent approximately 1.3 per cent of the bank’s outstanding common shares. As of May 20, 2016, there were 1,488,261,713 common shares outstanding. Purchases may commence on June 1, 2016, and continue until May 31, 2017. The price paid for any repurchased shares will be the prevailing market price at the time of acquisition. The amount of purchases on any given day will not exceed 694,769 common shares, which is 25 per cent of the average daily trading volume on the Toronto Stock Exchange for the six months ending April 30, 2016.
